title: Agent Roster: Contracts ke saath chhe specialised Subagents
summary: Chhe roster agents (architect, developer, reviewer, tester, security, sre) ko real `.claude/agents/*.md` files ki tarah banao, soch-samajh kar chune gaye model, tool, permission-mode aur skill choices ke saath, har ek ke liye ek Agent Contract, agent-scoped hooks jo write aur command scope enforce karte hain, aur ek zero-dependency conformance checker jo prove karta hai ki runtime files apne contracts se match karti hain. Reviewer v2 ki tarah ship hota hai, module 02 snapshot se improved, taaki module 09 difference measure kar sake.
prerequisites: Node 22 (guard aur checker scripts ke liye), Java 21 aur Maven 3.9 (tester aur developer ke liye)
Claude Code CLI installed aur authenticated (`claude --version`)

concepts.heading: Ek agent se roster tak: ek job, ek contract, ek handoff
concepts.body_md:
Module 02 ne ek single reviewer banaya tha jo kuch bhi kar sakta tha. Roster SDLC ko chhe narrow jobs mein baant deta hai, kyonki narrow agents ko **permission** dena, **evaluate** karna aur **trust** karna aasaan hota hai:

| Agent | Job | Code badalta hai? |
|---|---|---|
| `architect` | options, risks, ADR | nahi (sirf ADRs aur run folder) |
| `developer` | approved plan ko tests ke saath implement karna | haan |
| `reviewer` | diff par findings | nahi |
| `tester` | test strategy, missing tests, suite run | sirf tests |
| `security` | authN/Z, PHI, injection, secrets | nahi |
| `sre` | RCA, performance, deployability | nahi (patches propose karta hai) |

Har agent teen artifacts hai jo aapas mein agree karne chahiye:

- `AI-SDLC/.claude/agents/<name>.md`: runtime definition jo Claude Code load karta hai (verified format).
- `AI-SDLC/agents/<name>/CONTRACT.md`: Agent Contract (course convention, template module 01-foundations se).
- `.ai-sdlc/runs/<run-id>/NN-<name>.md` ke under ek **handoff**, `workflows/README.md` ke canonical format mein.

**Topology jaan-boojh kar flat hai.** Current Claude Code subagent ko subagents spawn karne deta hai (default mein teen layers tak, `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` ise badalta hai). Chhe mein se koi bhi `tools` mein `Agent` list nahi karta, aur chhe ke chhe `Agent` ko `disallowedTools` mein daalte hain, isliye har roster agent depth 1 par chalta hai aur har delegation decision main thread mein orchestrator leta hai (modules 07 aur 08). Isse runs auditable rehte hain: har step ka ek transcript, har step ka ek handoff.

Toh practically: jab kisi agent ko doosre agent ka skill chahiye, woh use call nahi karta. Woh apne handoff mein bata deta hai (`next: security`) aur orchestrator decide karta hai.

concepts.heading: Roster agent file ki anatomy
concepts.body_md:
Sirf `name` aur `description` required hain; unknown keys **chupchaap ignore** ho jaati hain, isliye `allowed-tools` (skill syntax) ya `permission-mode` jaisa typo bina kisi error ke fail hota hai. Roster sirf documented camelCase subagent fields use karta hai:

- `description`: kab delegate karna hai. Yeh trigger ka naam leta hai ("after the developer agent finishes") aur limit ka bhi ("Read-only; never edits files"). Claude tasks ko isi text ke against match karta hai.
- `tools`: ek **allowlist**. Ise chhod doge toh har tool inherit hota hai, MCP tools aur `Agent` samet.
- `disallowedTools`: doosra guard jo tab bhi bachta hai jab koi baad mein `tools` delete kar de.
- `model`, `effort`, `maxTurns`: har role ke liye cost aur depth (agle concepts).
- `permissionMode`: writers ke liye `acceptEdits`, read-only reviewers ke liye `dontAsk`, `sre` ke liye inherited.
- `skills`: start-up par poora skill content preload karta hai (architect: `architecture-review`; reviewer: `code-review`; tester: `test-strategy`, `run-tests`; security: `security-review`; sre: `performance-review`, `production-rca`; developer: `run-tests`). `disable-model-invocation: true` wala skill preload nahi ho sakta. `Skill` khud kisi bhi `tools` list mein nahi hai, isliye agents run ke beech mein doosre skills nahi kheench sakte.
- `hooks`: `PreToolUse` hooks jo sirf is agent ke andar chalte hain.
- `color`: taaki UI mein agents alag pehchaan sako.

**Body** hi poora system prompt hai: subagents ko Claude Code ka system prompt ya tumhari conversation nahi milti. Har roster body ke same saat parts hain: kaunse inputs milte hain, kaunsi context files padhni hain (path se), numbered procedure, exact handoff template, stop conditions, blocked hone par kya karna hai, aur ek chhoti "Never" list. Body apne CONTRACT.md ki taraf point karti hai aur kehti hai ki conflict hone par contract jeetega, jisse agent ke reviewers ko dekhne ke liye ek hi jagah milti hai.

concepts.heading: Layers mein least privilege: tools, hooks, permission rules, modes
concepts.body_md:
Chaar control layers (`tools`/`disallowedTools`, agent `hooks`, `permissions` rules, `permissionMode`) aur unki comparison table module 02-first-agent-skill-tools ("Controls for what an agent may do") mein sikhaayi gayi hai. Wahan se yaad rakho ki `disallowedTools` mein specifier poora tool hata deta hai aur `bypassPermissions`, `acceptEdits` aur `auto` parents ke under `permissionMode` ignore hota hai. Roster ek aur trap aur ek shared hook jodta hai:

- **`Write(...)` path rules kabhi consult nahi hote.** Sirf `Read(...)` aur `Edit(...)` path rules hote hain. Tum architect ke Write ko permission rule se `docs/adr/` tak scope nahi kar sakte, isliye write scope hook se aana chahiye.
- **`memory` Read, Write aur Edit ko auto-enable karta hai**, isliye koi read-only roster agent ise set nahi karta.

Hook hai `AI-SDLC/agents/tool-guard.mjs` (course pattern, built-in feature nahi), jo har agent ke frontmatter se do modes ke saath referenced hai: `write-scope <prefix>... [!protected]` aur `bash-allow <command-prefix>...`. Yeh hamesha block karta hai `git push`, `git commit`, mutating `kubectl`, recursive `rm`, `curl`/`wget`, `&&` ke alawa shell chaining, aur teen `git` flags jo read-only command ko kuch aur bana dete hain: `--output` (file likhta hai), `--no-index` (`.env` jaise arbitrary paths padhta hai, `Read` deny rules ko bypass karke), `--ext-diff` (program chalata hai). Unreadable input par yeh fail closed hota hai.

Ek precondition: Claude Code **project** agent ke frontmatter hooks tabhi chalata hai jab folder ke liye workspace trust dialog interactive session mein accept ho chuka ho. Jo folder kabhi trust nahi hua usme `claude -p` run unhe skip kar deta hai (yeh `.claude/settings.json` ke `permissions.allow` ko bhi ignore karta hai), jabki `block-secrets.mjs` jaise settings files ke hooks phir bhi chalte hain. Isliye is module ke headless exercises se pehle `AI-SDLC/` mein ek baar `claude` interactively start karo aur dialog accept karo.

Toh practically reviewer ka Bash tab bhi safe hai jab main session `acceptEdits` mein chal raha ho: mode ignore hota hai, hook nahi.

concepts.heading: Har role ke liye model, effort aur turn budget
concepts.body_md:
Model choice cost-of-error ka decision hai, prestige ka nahi.

| Agent | `model` | `effort` | `maxTurns` | Kyon |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| architect | `opus` | high | 30 | galat design hafton ka nuksaan karta hai; har feature par kam calls |
| security | `opus` | high | 30 | chhoota hua PHI leak hi mehenga failure hai |
| sre | `opus` | high | 30 | RCA ko code, manifests aur logs ke across hypotheses juggle karni padti hain |
| developer | `sonnet` | medium | 60 | bahut saare edit-test cycles; approved plan se guided |
| reviewer | `sonnet` | high | 25 | frequent; rigour preloaded checklist deti hai |
| tester | `sonnet` | medium | 40 | pattern follow karne wala test code, bahut saare Maven runs |

`haiku` use nahi hota: har roster job ko kai files ke across code padhna padta hai. Aliases (`opus`, `sonnet`) current model ko track karte hain; `claude-opus-5-5` jaisa full id tabhi pin karo jab reproducibility chahiye, jaise evals mein.

Evaluation ke liye resolution order matter karta hai: Agent call par per-invocation `model` jeetta hai, phir frontmatter `model`, phir `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`, phir main model. `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1` env model ko saare subagents par force karta hai. Jab module 09 reviewer v1 (`model: inherit`) ko v2 (`model: sonnet`) se compare kare, dono ko same model par pin karo (is module ka exercise v1 ke liye explicitly `model: sonnet` pass karta hai), taaki measured difference prompt, tools aur skills se aaye, model se nahi.

`maxTurns` ek stop condition hai, target nahi: jab yeh hit hota hai toh output partial mark hota hai, aur har roster body agent ko kehti hai ki partial work ko complete dikhane ki bajaye `status: blocked` return kare.

concepts.heading: Handoffs, read-only agents, aur achhe se rukna
concepts.body_md:
Har step ek handoff document par khatam hota hai (front matter `run_id`, `step`, `agent`, `status`, `inputs`, `next`; sections Summary, Findings, Decisions, Open questions, Artifacts). Ise kaun **likhta** hai yeh agent ke tools par depend karta hai:

- `architect`, `developer`, `tester` ke paas hook se `.ai-sdlc/runs/` tak scoped Write hai, isliye woh `NN-<agent>.md` khud likhte hain.
- `reviewer`, `security`, `sre` ke paas Write nahi hai. Unka **final message hi handoff document hai**, `---` se start hota hua, aur orchestrator use verbatim save karta hai (uska Write run folder tak limited hai). Headless mein `.result` tum khud save karte ho.

Reviewer ko "bas uski report ke liye" Write dena us code ko edit karne ka darwaza phir se khol deta jise woh review karta hai. Yeh bhi note karo ki `memory: project` **Read, Write aur Edit ko auto-enable karta hai**, isliye koi read-only roster agent `memory` use nahi karta.

`status` ki teen values hain aur har body exactly batati hai kab kaunsi use karni hai:

- `complete`: step ke exit criteria hold karte hain (developer ke liye: final code par `mvn -q -B test` pass hua).
- `blocked`: agent apne contract ke andar aage nahi badh sakta: empty diff, missing plan, hook denial, teen failed fix cycles, `maxTurns` paas.
- `needs-human`: decision kisi insaan ka hai: ADR likha gaya, public API badla, `SecurityConfig` chhua gaya, production mitigation propose hua.

Blocked hone par agent **kabhi variation ke saath retry nahi karta** (doosra path, pipe, alag tool). Guard ke around retry karna bilkul wahi behaviour hai jo tum repository access wale agent se nahi chahte. Woh denied action ko Open questions ke under record karta hai aur ruk jaata hai. Workflow runs ke dauraan `.claude/hooks/check-handoff.mjs` (module 08) `SubagentStop` par format validate karta hai.

concepts.heading: Reviewer v2: v1 se kya badla, aur kyon
concepts.body_md:
`AI-SDLC/evaluations/agent-versions/reviewer-v1.md` (module 02) ek theek-thaak pehla agent hai: achha role sentence, teen steps, "keep the review concise". Uska frontmatter hai `name`, `description`, `model: inherit`. Baaki sab inherit hota hai, aur yahi problem hai.

| Aspect | v1 | v2 (`.claude/agents/reviewer.md`) |
|---|---|---|
| Tools | koi listed nahi: sab inherit, incl. Edit, Write, Agent, MCP | `Read, Grep, Glob, Bash` + `disallowedTools` |
| Bash scope | kuch bhi | hook: sirf `git diff/log/show/status`; `dontAsk` |
| Standards | "project rules in CLAUDE.md" | `review-standards.md` padhta hai, rule numbers cite karta hai |
| Checklist | koi nahi | preloaded `code-review` skill |
| Output | free text | canonical handoff, six-column findings, verdict |
| Evidence | optional | quoted, Read result mein dekha gaya `path:line`; jo quote na ho sake woh findings drop |
| Clean categories | chup | har category ke liye "no findings" |
| Diff source | `git diff` ya "files the task mentions" | explicit range, inline diff, untracked files |
| Stop / blocked | koi nahi | empty diff, >40 files, `maxTurns`, fix requests |
| Injection | address nahi kiya | diff content data hai; injection ek finding hai |
| Teaching defect | report kar sakta hai | known, naya finding nahi |
| Model | `inherit` | `sonnet`, `effort: high`, `maxTurns: 25` |

Exercise 05-reviewer-v2 mein jo v1 failure tum reproduce karoge woh koi missed bug nahi hai; woh ek reviewer hai jo **usi file ko edit kar deta hai jise review kar raha hai** kyonki use koi rokta nahi, aur phir bina locations ke fixed aur unfixed items ka mix report karta hai. v2 edit nahi kar sakta, use quote karna padta hai, aur batana padta hai ki usne kya check kiya. Module 09 (09-agent-evaluation) dono versions ko `evaluations/datasets/reviewer-golden.json` ke golden tasks par recall, precision, hallucination rate aur tool violations ke liye measure karta hai.

05-roster-smoke-test.title: Roster files banao aur har agent ka smoke-test karo
05-roster-smoke-test.objective: Chhe mein se paanch roster agents banao (architect, developer, tester, security, sre; reviewer exercise 05-reviewer-v2 hai) unke Agent Contracts ke saath, phir `claude -p --agent <name>` se prove karo ki har ek apne system prompt ke saath load hota hai, aur architect ko ek real requirement par chalao: BUG-61, inactive patients ke liye Observations accept ho jaate hain (glossary business rule 3, jise `ObservationService.create` aaj enforce nahi karta).

testCases.name: Paanchon agents apne prompt ke saath load hote hain
testCases.expected: `success` wali paanch lines; har ek apna agent-specific handoff path batata hai. Generic jawab ("I am Claude Code") ka matlab hai file load nahi hui: `name` field check karo aur agar `.claude/agents/` abhi bana hai toh session restart karo.

testCases.name: Non-significant change ke liye architect sirf apna handoff likhta hai
testCases.expected: `docs/adr` ya `sample-app` ke under koi change nahi; run folder `01-requirements.md` aur `02-architect.md` list karta hai.

testCases.name: Handoff workflow validator pass karta hai
Architect ne real gap pakda
testCases.expected: 1 ya zyada: ek finding `ObservationService.create` mein `findById` lookup aur glossary business rule 3 cite karta hai.

testCases.name: Contracts valid hain
Security agent ke paas Bash nahi hai
testCases.expected: Agent batata hai ki uske paas koi shell tool nahi hai aur woh git nahi chala sakta; koi command output nahi dikhta.

evaluationCriteria: Har frontmatter key documented subagent field list mein hai; koi skill-style hyphenated keys nahi.
Har `description` batata hai kab delegate karna hai aur agent ki hard limit (read-only, kabhi push nahi).
Model aur effort choices cost of error se justified hain, aur justification contract ya module text mein hai.
Har body context files path se, ek numbered procedure, exact handoff template, stop conditions aur blocked behaviour list karti hai.
Koi roster agent `tools` mein `Agent` list nahi karta; chhe ke chhe use `disallowedTools` mein list karte hain.
Architect handoff current behaviour ke liye `path:line` cite karta hai aur kam se kam ek option ko concrete reason ke saath reject karta hai.
improvements: Developer mein `isolation: worktree` jodo taaki har implementation temporary git worktree mein chale; reviewer ka input update karo taaki woh us worktree ki branch ka diff le.
sre agent ko raw `kubectl logs` ki bajaye read-only metrics server ke liye `mcpServers` do (module 06).
Reproducible evals ke liye security par `model: claude-opus-5-5` pin karo aur architect ko `opus` alias rakhne do.
Architect mein `initialPrompt` jodo taaki `claude --agent architect` `.ai-sdlc/runs/` ke open runs list karke start ho.

05-reviewer-v2.title: Reviewer v2: tight karo, structure do aur v1 se compare karo
05-reviewer-v2.objective: Module 02 ke reviewer (`evaluations/agent-versions/reviewer-v1.md`) ko `.claude/agents/reviewer.md` v2 mein badlo, explicit tool allowlist, ek Bash hook, `dontAsk`, preloaded `code-review` skill, canonical handoff aur stop conditions ke saath. Ek seeded diff apply karo jo chaar real defects ke saath birth-date search jodta hai, dono versions ko us par chalao, aur woh differences record karo jo module 09 measure karega.

testCases.name: Seeded diff apply hota hai aur build abhi bhi hota hai
testCases.expected: `checking file sample-app/src/main/java/org/example/fhir/api/PatientController.java` aur `...PatientRepository.java`, phir Maven exit 0 (25 tests): defects current suite ko dikhte hi nahi.

testCases.name: v2 chaaron seeded defects report karta hai
testCases.expected: Kam se kam: `high security` (line 54 par PHI log), `high testing` (koi tests nahi), `medium correctness` (LocalDate.parse, 500), `medium design` (controller se repository).

testCases.name: v2 ne kuch edit nahi kiya
testCases.expected: `2 files changed, 20 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)`: bilkul patch jitna, reviewer ne kuch nahi joda.

testCases.name: v1 vs v2 tool behaviour
testCases.expected: v2: `0` (yeh apni allowlist ke bahar kabhi tool try nahi karta). v1: aksar `1` ya zyada, typically `PatientController.java` par ek `Edit`; module 09 ke tool-violation metric ke liye number record karo.

testCases.name: v2 verdict blocking rule follow karta hai
testCases.expected: `Verdict: BLOCK.` kyonki kam se kam ek finding high hai.

testCases.name: Har category ka hisaab hai
Contract aur runtime agree karte hain

evaluationCriteria: v2 `tools` aur `disallowedTools` list karta hai; v1 ke inherited Edit/Write/Agent chale gaye.
Har v2 finding ka `path:line` patch ke baad exist karta hai aur ek verbatim quote hai.
Severities `code-review` skill guide se match karti hain (logs mein PHI high, controller-to-repository medium).
Handoff `.claude/hooks/check-handoff.mjs` se validate hota hai aur final message ki tarah return hota hai, reviewer use likhta nahi.
Write-up kam se kam teen v1-to-v2 differences ka naam leta hai aur predict karta hai ki har ek module 09 ka kaunsa metric move karega.
improvements: Birth-date patch ko chaar expected findings ke saath `evaluations/datasets/reviewer-golden.json` mein golden task ki tarah jodo (dataset module 09 ka hai).
Headless runs mein reviewer se `--json-schema` structured output nikalwao taaki eval harness ko Markdown tables parse na karni padein.
Review ka security part poori tarah alag karo: `security` findings ko khud rate karne ki bajaye `next: security` se route karo.

05-tool-guards-and-denials.title: Write aur command scope enforce karo, aur ek denial prove karo
05-tool-guards-and-denials.objective: Agent-scoped PreToolUse guard `agents/tool-guard.mjs` likho, real hook input JSON ke saath use offline test karo, phir headless run mein prove karo ki project allow rules ke bahar ka command deny hota hai aur result ke `permission_denials` array mein dikhta hai, aur denial hataane par (ek local allow rule) woh gayab ho jaata hai.

testCases.name: Guard unit tests pass hote hain
Push exit 2 aur reason ke saath block hota hai
Architect application code nahi likh sakta
Read deny ko git ke through bypass nahi kiya ja sakta
testCases.expected: `git diff --no-index (reads arbitrary paths, e.g. .env)` ka naam lene wala message aur `2`.

testCases.name: Denial headless mein dikhta hai
testCases.expected: `permission_denials` mein ek `Bash` entry hai jiske `tool_input.command` mein `mvn -q -B compile` hai; `result` kehta hai ki command permitted nahi tha.

testCases.name: Allow rule denial hata deta hai
testCases.expected: `permission_denials` `[]` hai; `git status --short` dikhata hai ki `.claude/settings.local.json` phir se hat gaya.

evaluationCriteria: Guard exit code 2 se block karta hai (exit 1 block nahi karta) aur stderr mein actionable reason likhta hai.
Malformed JSON aur unknown modes par yeh fail closed hota hai.
Path checks matching se pehle `..` aur absolute paths ko `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` ke against resolve karte hain.
Chaining (`;`, `|`, backticks, `$(`, redirects, `&`) reject hoti hai; sirf allowed commands ke beech `&&` pass hota hai.
Learner samjha sakta hai ki developer ke liye `disallowedTools: Bash(git push *)` kyon use nahi hua.
improvements: Har block ko `.ai-sdlc/guard.log` mein log karo (sirf ids aur command names) aur settings mein ek `PermissionDenied` hook jodo taaki permission-layer denials usi file mein collect hon.
Prefix matching ki jagah ek chhota tokenizer lagao taaki `|` wale quoted arguments (jaise `git log --format='%h|%s'`) allowed hon.
Always-deny list ko `.claude/settings.json` `permissions.deny` mein le jao (woh file module 10-governance ki hai) taaki yeh main session ko bhi cover kare.

05-contract-conformance.title: Roster ke liye contract-conformance check likho aur chalao
05-contract-conformance.objective: `agents/check-agents.mjs` likho, ek zero-dependency Node script jo har `.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter parse kare aur fail ho jab koi key undocumented ho, naam roster ke bahar ho, koi roster agent delegate kar sake, `disallowedTools` specifier poora tool hata de, `memory` kisi read-only agent ko Write de de, preloaded skill missing ho ya preloadable na ho, hook event exist na kare, ya tools agent ke CONTRACT.md se alag hon. Ise real roster par aur jaan-boojh kar tode gaye copies par chalao.

testCases.name: Shipped roster conform karta hai
testCases.expected: Roster ke liye chhe `PASS` lines (plus orchestrator) aur `0`. Jo canonical skills abhi disk par nahi hain unke warnings allowed hain; errors nahi.

testCases.name: Checker tests pass hote hain
Skill-style key pakdi jaati hai
Delegation pakda jaata hai
testCases.expected: `error: roster agents must not list Agent/Task in tools (flat, auditable, depth 1)` plus `agents/security/CONTRACT.md` ke against ek tools-drift error.

testCases.name: Machine-readable mode

evaluationCriteria: Zero dependencies; `AI-SDLC/` se `node agents/check-agents.mjs` ke saath Node 22 par chalta hai.
Documented-key list `build/CLAUDE_CODE_FACTS.md` section 1 se bilkul match karti hai.
Tool lists sirf top-level commas par split hoti hain, isliye `Agent(architect, developer)` ek entry ki tarah parse hota hai.
Har rule ka ek failing test hai jo real agent file se bana hai, synthetic string se nahi.
Exit codes failures (1) ko usage errors (2) se alag karte hain, taaki CI us par gate kar sake.
improvements: Checker ko CI mein aur matcher `project_settings` ke saath `ConfigChange` hook ki tarah chalao taaki agent files ke edits save par check hon (module 10-governance).
`model`, `permissionMode` aur `maxTurns` ko bhi har CONTRACT.md ke permissions paragraph mein likhi values se compare karo.
Sirf script path exist karta hai yeh check karne ki bajaye validate karo ki har hook `command` sach mein start hota hai (sample input ke saath spawn karo).

agentContracts.purpose: Ek requirement ya change request ko FHIR-lite API ke liye architecture decision mein badlo: use existing packages, endpoints aur tables par map karo, kam se kam do options compare karo, ek recommend karo, risks ko findings ki tarah list karo, aur decision significant ho toh ADR draft karo. Iska output kisi insaan ko code likhe jaane se pehle design approve karne deta hai aur developer ko implementation outline deta hai. Yeh kabhi application code nahi likhta aur kabhi apna ADR khud accept nahi karta.
inputs: Run id aur two-digit step number (required, task message mein; missing ho toh agent `workflows/README.md` format mein ek derive karta hai, jaise `2026-09-30-feat-patient-pagination`, step `00` use karta hai aur yeh record karta hai).
Requirement: inline text ya `.ai-sdlc/runs/2026-09-30-feat-observation-search/01-requirements.md` jaisa handoff path (required).
`context/architecture/overview.md`, `context/standards/coding-standards.md`, `context/standards/api-standards.md` (hamesha padhe jaate hain).
`context/security/threat-model.md` (tab padha jaata hai jab change authentication, authorization, PHI fields, logging ya search parameters ko chhoota hai).
`docs/adr/` ke existing ADRs aur `sample-app/` ka woh code jise change chhoota hai (`path:line` cite karne ke liye padha jaata hai).
outputs: Canonical front matter aur sections ke saath handoff file `.ai-sdlc/runs/<run-id>/NN-architect.md`, jisme "Decisions" ke under implementation outline aur required tests hain.
Significant decisions ke liye (naya endpoint, schema change, nayi dependency, security ya PHI change): `docs/adr/0000-template.md` se `Status: proposed` ke saath `docs/adr/NNNN-kebab-title.md`.
Main session ko final message: chhota summary aur likhe gaye paths.

agentContracts.purpose: Evidence (code, manifests, logs, read-only cluster state) se samjhao ki FHIR-lite API slow kyon hai, fail kyon ho raha hai ya deploy karne ke liye unsafe kyon hai, aur teen horizons mein sabse chhota safe remediation propose karo: mitigate, fix, prevent. Yeh incident responders aur release owners ki madad karta hai. Yeh kabhi code, configuration ya cluster nahi badalta; fixes handoff mein patches ki tarah propose hote hain aur human approval ke baad developer unhe implement karta hai.

agentContracts.permissions: Frontmatter: `tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash`, `disallowedTools: Agent, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit, WebFetch, WebSearch`, koi `permissionMode` nahi (yeh parent mode inherit karta hai, isliye `default` mein har `kubectl` call insaan ko prompt karta hai: cluster access par jaan-boojh kar lagaya human gate), preloaded skills `performance-review` aur `production-rca`. Ek agent-scoped `PreToolUse` hook, `agents/tool-guard.mjs bash-allow 'kubectl get' ...`, baaki sab ke liye exit 2 karta hai aur hamesha mutating ya interactive `kubectl` (`apply`, `delete`, `scale`, `rollout restart|undo`, `exec`, `port-forward`) block karta hai. Project settings `kubectl apply *` ko `ask` aur `kubectl delete *` ko `deny` ki tarah jodti hain. Cluster credentials insaan ka kubeconfig hain; real incidents ke liye agent ko read-only service account context do.
